direction_as_read: positive_weak: one small rosehip extract trial meets the bar on a surrogate (25834460); the osteoarthritis evidence is seed and shell powder at 5 g/day, manufacturer supported (18407528), and a 120-person powder trial showed no between-group difference (41599942)
summary: Seven labels print rosehip fruit extract 500 mg and three print rose hips at 7.5 to 20 mg inside vitamin C products that carry an immune claim. The stored evidence is seed and shell powder at 5 g/day in osteoarthritis (16195164), a preparation and amount no label prints. One study of extract meets the reading bar: 32 preobese adults on 100 mg/day for 12 weeks, where abdominal fat area, a stated primary outcome, fell more than placebo while body fat percent only tended to (25834460). Other oral trials name no primary outcome in the abstract (42831964, 29024081), test powder (19818588, 18407528) or a 40 g food amount (22166897). A 120-person powder trial found no between-group difference in WOMAC (41599942). No immune trial was found in the search. Abstracts only.
